nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core type and trait surface for turn execution: permission verdicts/providers, turn configuration and results, tool-hook interventions, and the TurnEventHandler trait consumers implement to observe streaming deltas, tool calls, and context usage during a turn.

nodes.name: PermissionVerdict
nodes.summary: Enum expressing the outcome of a tool-permission check: allow, deny, or allow-and-remember.

nodes.name: PermissionProvider
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting permission checking so the turn executor can request approval before running a tool without depending on a concrete implementation.

nodes.name: TurnIterationHook
nodes.summary: Trait hook invoked before each LLM iteration within a turn, letting callers inject steering or side effects.

nodes.name: SteeringInjection
nodes.summary: Represents a mid-turn steering message to inject into the LLM conversation, tagged with its originating turn intent.

nodes.name: TurnConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bag controlling a single turn's execution: model selection, iteration/token limits, concurrency, and optional hooks/queues.

nodes.name: TurnResult
nodes.summary: Aggregate result returned by turn execution, carrying final content, message history, and token/usage telemetry.

nodes.name: ToolHookIntervention
nodes.summary: Represents a hook's decision to block or modify a tool call before it executes.

nodes.name: TurnEventHandler
nodes.summary: Central event-callback trait implemented by turn-execution consumers to observe/react to streaming deltas, tool calls, file changes, and context-usage updates during a turn.

nodes.name: usage_accumulator.rs
nodes.summary: Accumulates running token-usage totals (prompt/completion/cache) across a turn's LLM calls.

nodes.name: UsageTotals
nodes.summary: Running totals of prompt/completion/cache token usage accumulated across a turn's LLM calls.

nodes.name: usage_telemetry.rs
nodes.summary: Defines telemetry spans and per-tool-call token attribution used to build a detailed usage report for a turn, including how completion tokens are split across concurrent tool calls.

nodes.name: AttributionMethod
nodes.summary: Enum identifying how completion tokens were attributed to a specific tool call when usage cannot be measured directly.

nodes.name: LlmUsageSpan
nodes.summary: Snapshot of token usage and context stats for one LLM call iteration within a turn.

nodes.name: ToolExecutionUsage
nodes.summary: Byte-size record of a single tool call's input/output payload used for usage attribution.

nodes.name: ToolUsageAttribution
nodes.summary: Attributes decision and follow-up completion tokens to a specific tool call, recording the attribution method used.

nodes.name: UsageTelemetry
nodes.summary: Container aggregating all LLM usage spans and tool usage attributions collected for a turn.

nodes.name: PendingDecisionAttribution
nodes.summary: Holds an in-flight decision's completion-token count and attribution method pending association with tool results.

nodes.name: UsageTelemetryCollector
nodes.summary: Stateful collector that records LLM spans and attributes completion tokens across concurrent tool calls to build the turn's UsageTelemetry.

nodes.name: debug.rs
nodes.summary: Curated `#[doc(hidden)]` re-export barrel exposing internal session/orchestration/command helpers to the app crate's debug/test HTTP routes without widening agent-core's documented public API.

nodes.name: event_pipeline_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Dependency-injection bridge that registers pluggable callback implementations (event push/persist, streaming finalize, session pin/unpin, tool-arg merging) so the foundation event bus can dispatch into the concrete session layer without a direct crate dependency.

nodes.name: PersistedUserMessageSource
nodes.summary: Enum tagging whether a persisted user message originated from a direct user submission or an agent-org inbox transcript replay.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the full set of callback implementations (event persistence, streaming finalize, session pin/unpin, tool-arg updates) that the event bus bridge dispatches to.

nodes.name: push_events
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to push a batch of events onto a session's event stream.

nodes.name: schedule_notify
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to schedule a frontend notification for session updates.

nodes.name: update_spawning_tool_args
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to merge additional arguments into pending tool calls matching given function names.

nodes.name: update_tool_args_by_call_id
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to merge arguments into a specific tool call identified by call_id.

nodes.name: complete_tool_call_by_call_id
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to mark a tool call as completed (success/failure) by its call id.

nodes.name: finalize_streaming
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to finalize any in-progress streaming buffers for a session.

nodes.name: set_session_streaming
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to toggle a session's streaming flag.

nodes.name: replace_streaming_event
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to swap a placeholder streaming event with its finalized event.

nodes.name: remove_events_by_ids
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to remove a set of events from a session's event stream by id.

nodes.name: pin_session
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to pin a session so its events remain visible/prioritized in the UI.

nodes.name: unpin_session
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to unpin a previously pinned session.

nodes.name: read_session_events
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to read the current event list for a session.

nodes.name: finalize_plan_revision_events
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to finalize events tied to a specific plan revision.

nodes.name: persist_events
nodes.summary: Persists a batch of events synchronously with retry, logging under the given label on failure.

nodes.name: persist_events_async
nodes.summary: Persists a batch of events asynchronously with retry, logging under the given label on failure.

nodes.name: persist_user_message_event
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered callback to persist a new user message event, tagging its source and originating turn intent.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Defines InboundMessage and OutboundMessage structs for the message bus, carrying channel/content/media metadata with session-key derivation for routing.

nodes.name: InboundMessage
nodes.summary: Represents an inbound message arriving on the message bus from an external channel, deriving a session key for routing.

nodes.name: OutboundMessage
nodes.summary: Represents an outbound message to be published to an external channel via the message bus.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the MessageBus wrapping tokio mpsc/broadcast channels for routing inbound and outbound messages, and wires the bus submodules (event_pipeline_bridge, events).

nodes.name: MessageBus
nodes.summary: Central pub/sub message bus wrapping tokio mpsc/broadcast channels for routing inbound and outbound messages between the bus and session handlers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new MessageBus with fresh inbound and outbound channels.

nodes.name: broadcast_event
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a typed event with a JSON payload to all subscribed frontend listeners via the registered broadcast callback.
